title: LAL-D individual participant data review: data and code
description: Data and R code for "Lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (LAL-D). It is necessary to change to multimodal therapy: A systematic review and long-term follow-up of Mexican probands" (PROSPERO CRD42024505308), as submitted to the Journal of Inherited Metabolic Disease. The data comprise 463 participants from 234 published reports and one institutional case series, 426 group-level results from 30 reports, and the 318 reports retrieved with their PubMed identifiers and DOIs, with a data dictionary. Running run_all.R reproduces Figures 1–3, Tables 1, 2 and S4–S8, and the estimates reported in the text. Code: MIT licence (LICENSE); data: CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
